example_label: Example data. Fictional agency and AI system. Not a real assessment.

answers.q5_changes: State staff loaded public park maps. No vendor and no outside model.
answers.q6_description: The helper forecasts how long mowing will take on each park map and suggests a weekly order for crews. It runs on the agency network. A crew coordinator sets the real schedule. Fictional system.
answers.q7_purpose: Crew leads now build the weekly mowing order on a whiteboard. The helper proposes an order from acreage and season. It does not serve or deny a resident. Fictional purpose.
answers.q8_how: It orders park maps for routine grounds checks. It does not decide a case.
answers.q14_sources: Park boundary maps and crew schedules held by the park maintenance unit.
answers.q20_harm: A bad forecast could send a crew to a small park first and leave a larger park late. The cost is staff time and a messier public park, not a decision about a person.
